approvers: Site manager, project director, client/developer if cost is passed on
reason: We spend about 3,670 a year on frame film and nothing on the glass, and 19 per m2 is a big jump for damage we mostly absorb or claim back from the glazing sub. A 50% deposit up front when we pay our own suppliers at 60 to 90 days is a non-starter.
objection: 19 per m2 all-in plus a deposit, when what I use now costs nothing. I can't show my director that it beats a few cleaning crews and the odd pane replacement.
instead: Keep the factory film on the profiles, have the glazing sub cover the glass with cheap protection film or tape, and pay for cleaning and the occasional replacement at handover.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from a Maltese contractor of our size showing it cost less than the glass damage and cleaning it replaced, a trial on one floor at their cost, and 60-day terms with no deposit.
